plain: In 2013, near the airport at Aguadilla, a tourist town in Puerto Rico, a heat-sensing camera filmed a small object moving low over the area. Mick West, a well-known skeptic who studies UFO videos, discusses the footage in a debate on Jesse Michels's podcast and points out that it was taken right over the airport. Michels describes the same video differently on a later episode. He calls it about three minutes long and says it shows a transmedium object, meaning one that moves between air and water. According to Michels, the object seems to go down into the Atlantic Ocean and then come back out. West and Michels read the same footage in opposite directions. To those who see it Michels's way, it would show a craft able to travel through both sky and sea.
